format: JSONL — one JSON object per line, append-only

common_fields.seq: integer, monotonic from 1, no gaps or duplicates
common_fields.type: one of the event types below
common_fields.prev_hash: sha256 hex of the previous event's canonical form; 'GENESIS' for seq 1

command.note: evidence in {real}; a non-zero exit is allowed only for items whose desired behavior is failure (e.g. rejecting an invalid runtime)

test.note: evidence in {real, presence, live}; only evidence=real passing tests may back a PASS/VERIFIED verdict — presence/echo is contract evidence only

verdict.note: result in {VERIFIED, NOT_VERIFIED, PASS, FAIL}; backed_by is a list of event seqs

integrity_rules: exactly one run_start at seq 1; exactly one verdict as the last event
hash chain: prev_hash of event n equals sha256 of the canonical form of event n-1
every command has an integer exit_code and stdout/stderr sha256 (replayable)
no raw secret values anywhere (only [REDACTED]); env vars by NAME only
run_start.base_sha == frozen base; contract_bundle_sha256 and rubric_sha256 == contract.lock.json
the required lane transcript must exist and (under --require-head) match the current head — absence/stale head is NOT VERIFIED
a VERIFIED/PASS verdict must be backed by >=1 real (evidence=real) passing test and must not coexist with any failed test or failure event
presence/echo/mock checks are contract evidence only (evidence in {presence, live}) and can never carry a benchmark success
